IA-boone-railroad-shop-workers.alt: 1916 fire insurance map showing the curved Chicago and North Western roundhouse around a turntable, the machine shop, and parallel railroad tracks in Boone, Iowa.
IA-boone-railroad-shop-workers.credit: Sanborn Map Company, April 1916, sheet 9. Library of Congress, Geography and Map Division, Sanborn Maps Collection. Public domain.
IA-boone-railroad-shop-workers.sourceName: Library of Congress — Sanborn Maps Collection, item sanborn02583_006
IA-boone-railroad-shop-workers.dateNote: April 1916. This sheet documents the railroad shops at the Boone stop. It does not establish the Lincoln Highway alignment or public access to the historic rail yard.
IA-boone-railroad-shop-workers.caption: Boone's Chicago & North Western roundhouse, turntable, machine shop and adjoining yard, mapped in April 1916.
